claimed_vs_measured: Everything in dry-run is measured by test.sh: 29 checks, all passing on 2026-09-03 (four entries exit 0 and complete; agents.json and the workflow validate against their schemas with the same validator; the ledger chain verifies and a one-character edit is detected; a replay appends nothing; the budget trips both before execution and mid-loop; a malformed envelope returns RFC 9457 problem details and writes no ledger). Live mode is claimed until run against the gateway: OpenAICompatibleAdapter has never been executed here, so the request shape, the cost field, and the correlation headers are unverified against a real endpoint. The Dispatch request/result and problem-details shapes are simplified subsets of D-design-001, D-design-002 and D-design-006, which are themselves claimed. The workflow and agent-profile schemas are ours (proposed), not adopted standards.
